content.description:
Company Description Shadowfax is a leading technology-driven logistics platform powering India’s fast-moving commerce economy. For over 11 years, it has enabled major brands such as Nykaa, Myntra, AJIO, Meesho, Mokobara, and Dot & Key to deliver efficiently across the country. The company offers a full spectrum of services, including same-day and next-day delivery, hyperlocal fulfilment, express parcel, reverse logistics, and supply chain solutions. Shadowfax operates a vast network across 15,656+ PIN codes, supported by hundreds of thousands of delivery partners and extensive infrastructure, and has completed over 1.5 billion shipments. Through technology, intelligent automation, and sustainable mobility, Shadowfax is building the future of commerce movement in India.
Role Description The Rider role at Shadowfax is a full-time, on-site position based in Shaikpet. Riders are responsible for picking up and delivering packages safely and on time, following assigned routes and delivery schedules. Day-to-day tasks include verifying order details, maintaining communication with the local hub or supervisor, and using mobile applications for navigation and delivery confirmation. Riders are expected to handle parcels with care, follow traffic and safety regulations, and provide a courteous experience to customers at the point of delivery. The role may also involve basic documentation, cash or digital payment handling when required, and reporting any delivery issues or delays promptly.
Qualifications
 Candidates should possess strong navigation and route-planning abilities, including familiarity with local Shaikpet areas and the use of smartphone-based maps or delivery apps.Candidates should possess safe driving or riding skills, a valid driving license for two-wheeler or appropriate vehicle, and adherence to traffic and road safety rules.Candidates should possess basic communication and customer service skills to interact politely with customers and coordinate effectively with supervisors and hub staff.Candidates should possess time management and reliability skills, including the ability to manage multiple deliveries, meet deadlines, and maintain punctuality.Candidates should possess physical stamina sufficient for extended riding and handling packages throughout the workday.Relevant qualifications such as previous delivery or logistics experience, familiarity with last-mile operations, and basic smartphone literacy are beneficial.Ability to read and understand delivery instructions in English or local language, and willingness to work flexible shifts including weekends and peak hours is preferred.

Shadowfax employs tech-enabled solutions like ML and AI to offer supply that keeps pace with demand in the fast-growing and highly fragmented hyperlocal distribution ecosystem and ensures a wonderful end-user experience.. . The Shadowfax app has over two million downloads and is designed as an immersive platform for delivery and is a single app that works across multiple platforms. The app is used as a channel for guaranteed earnings across multiple E-com and Hyperlocal platforms. Shadowfax has been consistently widening its area of operations by expanding in E-commerce and Hyperlocal segments and getting into new growth areas like grocery distribution.. Shadowfax has extremely friendly people and partnership policies that are designed to be highly empathetic and are always looking for ways to make the riders lives better and transform the appeal of delivery and other blue-collar jobs as an attractive career option. Working with the Shadowfax platform ensures strong earning potential along with a high degree of flexibility and freedom along with financial support services like loans, and insurance.. . In October 2021, Shadowfax launched India’s first delivery SuperApp to accelerate the growth of delivery partners by empowering them to access multiple opportunities via a single platform.. Shadowfax is India’s largest on-demand tech-enabled instant third-party logistics (3PL) platform. It is the only Indian B2C last-mile delivery platform disrupting logistics with services in multiple categories, including food, groceries, quick commerce, multi-city e-commerce fulfillment, and reverse logistics under a single umbrella. On the back of a fast-growing base of 120,000+ monthly transacting delivery partners, Shadowfax serves over 170+ enterprise clients across 900+ cities, delivering over 10 Lakh + orders every day. Shadowfax was founded by IIT - Delhi Alumni, Abhishek Bansal, Vaibhav Khandelwal, Praharsh Chandra and Gaurav Jaithliya in 2015. Our clients are present across sectors like e-commerce, food, grocery, FMCG, electronics, consumer durables, pharma, apparel, auto, BFSI and Insurance etc.. . We foster a culture that values first principle thinking and problem solving, encourages constructive feedback, engagement, inclusion and diversity at all levels. Our core values define our identity and form the basis of our actions and reflect in everything that we do at Shadowfax. . Business Head – Courier. The business Head role is to create and manage the top line and bottom-line of a pan India courier business from scratch. The person is expected to create a blueprint, test market and scale up business to become Top 3 player in the country.. Should be able to supervise and ensure the operational efficiency in courier service. This includes managing both the resources and processes to identify, recommend, develop, implement, and support business friendly solutions for all aspects of operations.. Role expectations-. Handled Pan country Sales/ Operations/ Business role in courier/ logistics industry in past. Able to scale up Business from scratch- Developing operational manual and other strategic documents to run the business efficiency. Create and grow the Franchisee and B2B business- Financial responsibility for revenue growth, cost control, debt collection and overall responsibility for budgetary deliverables. Work closely with cross functional departments like Product, Tech, Last mile, mid mile and first mile Ops to ensure service delivery. Market intelligence gathering through monitoring competitor activities and generation and analysis of reports pertaining to the same. Ensuring service levels in terms of delivery and collection are met through monitoring of service levels returns. To ensure all pickups are performed on time to meet committed service standards and the documentation is correct. Must haves. MBA from Top Tier Institute. Handled business size in excess of 100 Cr. Handled team size of 200+. Strong in P&L Management. Franchisee Management. Created and scaled up business. Able to manage ambiguity. Well versed with latest tech, worked closely with product team in past. . . Show more. . . Show less. . . .
